purpose: Validate sensor-only object measurements before three-sensor association and EKF tracking
validation_checks: Verify target actor presence in held-out GT
Verify target is visually identifiable in Camera RGB
Verify LiDAR target surface measurements exist
Verify Radar returns near the target geometry
Verify nominal sensor mounts and projection model
Audit exact repeated measurements per sensor
Separate sensor-only detections from GT evaluation
Report missing detections instead of inventing matches
Quantify positional error only for validated associations
Verify all experiment files and recording hashes

acceptance.camera: Visible target and documented sensor-only image localization
acceptance.lidar: Evidence of target-related geometry with held-out GT evaluation
acceptance.radar: Radar geometry assessed against independently validated target position
acceptance.association: Explicit sensor-only matching rule with ambiguity and unmatched outcomes
acceptance.synchronization: Timing uncertainty documented; no unsupported acquisition-time claim
acceptance.quality: Detection, association and error statistics computed from actual observations
acceptance.failure_policy: Failed scenario remains documented and is not silently excluded

known_limitations: Existing 372-frame recording contains large ground-like LiDAR components
Camera projection is nominal and physically uncalibrated
Radar Doppler has startup and all-zero review conditions
Recorder timestamps do not prove acquisition synchronization
Controlled scene implementation and measurements remain pending

final_evaluation_separation.energy_measurements: Future hardware benchmarking, not part of this recording acceptance
